lines: “骗子！大骗子！”
一个愤怒的娇喝，紧接着响起脚掌踩着青石地面逃走的声音。
张悬无奈的伸出双手：“我真不是骗子，是学院的老师……只是想让你做我的学生！而且，就算说我是骗子，干嘛还要加个‘大’字？搞得我跟十恶不赦一样……”
嘀咕完，想起政教主任说过的话，张悬揉揉眉心：“第十七个了！今天如果连一个学生都招不到，明天我就可以卷铺盖回家了！”
张悬本不是这个世界的人，而是地球的一个普通高校图书馆的管理员，只记得熊熊大火，然后……就没有然后了，再次醒来到了这个世界。
和小说中记述的差不多，武道为尊，实力为王！
本以为能穿越个废柴，惨遭退婚，然后打脸逆袭，一路高歌……看来想多了，到了这里，才发现居然不是学员，而是……老师！
整个学院最悲催的一位老师！
别人的课堂，都是人满为患，拥挤的坐不下去，而他的课堂，一个都没有，好不容易被他拉进来几个，最后都连骂好几声“骗子”，转身就逃！
究其原因，被自己魂穿的家伙，教师中实力最低不说，还眼光极差，啥都看不出来，关键……还教错，出过一例走火入魔！
这和医院死人一样，名气大损，受人唾弃，哪怕新来的学员，也一个个敬而远之，生怕落到他手里，被教个半死不活！
没有学生，又遭到诟病，去年的师资考评，整个学院倒数第一，甚至得到了历史上唯一的零分。
郁闷之下，借酒浇愁，结果如愿以偿的挂了，自己借机穿越过来。
新学期开始，学院下了最后通牒，如果今年他的课堂上再无法招收一个学生，就直接开除教师资格！
今天已经十七个新学员路过他的教室了，结果，一听到名字，全都无一例外的逃走，像是小姑娘遇到了怪蜀黍，有多快跑多快。
“看来必须想办法忽悠一个才行！”
心中正在想应该怎么开口拉人，就见一个一脸呆萌的女孩的从门口露出脑袋。
“请问，这里是陆寻老师的课堂吗？”
声音甜美，可爱，模样清秀，可人。
陆寻老师，学院的明星教师，课堂每次都是爆满，无数人慕名而来。
“就她了！”见有人自投罗网，张悬眼睛一亮。
将前世看过的各种装逼套路回忆一遍，安静坐在座位上，摆了个世外高人的姿势：“你想拜他为师？”
女孩麻雀般连连点头，乌黑的双眼中，满是崇拜：“我听说陆寻老师是洪天学院最厉害的教师，教授的学生，个个实力非凡，大家都以能加入他的课堂为荣！”
“传闻未必是真的，老师和鞋一样，在于适合不适合！他讲的再好，与你的修炼理论不合，非但不会进步，弄不好还会后退！老师名气不显，与你理论相合，也能快速进步，修为大增！”
“是这样啊……我也听哥哥说过了类似的话！”女孩愣了一下，美丽的双眸有些迷茫：“不过，我不知道自己适合什么样的课堂！”
见她上钩，张悬眼睛一亮，犹豫了一下，马克思、恩科斯等先贤在脑海接连浮现，装出一副为难的样子：“相逢就是缘，这样吧，我也是这个学院的教师，可以免费帮你看看根骨、天赋、秉性，顺便帮你推荐一个合适的老师！”
“那就劳烦先生了！”没想到随便遇到的这位教师，如此大义，女孩兴奋的连忙点头。
“你先展示一下修为让我看看！”
张悬眼睛半睁半闭，似乎毫不在意。
呼呼呼呼呼！
片刻功夫，房间里拳风呼啸，一道道气劲游龙般在女孩身上乱窜，整个人气息，凝而不散，威而不显，代表了她有极好的基础。
“好了，我看出来了，你平时修炼认真刻苦，基础扎实，天赋绝佳，是不可多见的天才！”一套拳打完，张悬满意的点头。
他这是和地球上的算命先生学的，话都是万金油，范围很广，让人听不出来错误，反而暗呼准确。
“尤其是你双腿上的力量，盘龙一般，一举一动，犹如滔滔江水，无穷无尽，以后好好修炼的话，肯定很有前途……”
“老师，我腿上受过伤，医师说，基本等同废了……”女孩打断他的滔滔不绝，眼中有些疑惑。
“受伤……”张悬老脸一红，不过，脸皮厚，别人也看不出来，继续胡侃乱煽：“你以为我没看出来吗？刚才你施展力量的时候，我就知道了！之所以那么说，是因为……不破不立！你双腿虽然受伤，却意外得到了其他人都意想不到的机缘，以后好好把握的话，你的腿功，必然成为最强战斗力！让其他人望尘莫及！”
反正都是忽悠，能瞎说，就瞎说，先忽悠过来一个弟子再说。
“机缘？老师，是什么样的机缘？”女孩眼睛一亮。
她腿伤了之后，一直觉得不如别人，暗生自卑，没想到还有可能因祸得福。
“这个机缘，可以让你一飞冲天，成为新生第一也不为过，毕竟你天赋本就很好，是万古无一的绝世天才，不过……”张悬海口连连，就差没拿出一本“如来神掌”了。
听到可以成为新生第一，又夸她是天才，女孩脸上情不自禁的露出火热，连忙询问：“不过，什么？”
“不过……”张悬叹息一声，一副良才即将遭到埋没的感叹：“能看出这种机缘的老师整个学院都不多了！加上我，也只有三个，其他两位，三年前就已经不收学生，所以……我也不好帮你开口……”
“不收学生？”女孩本来抱着很大希望，听到这话眼神略微黯淡了一下，随即想通了什么猛地跳起：“他们不收学生，那老师你……收不收？”
content_en:
"Liar! Big liar!"
An angry yell was heard, followed by the sound of feet stepping on the bluestone ground and escaping.
Zhang Xuan stretched out his hands helplessly: "I am really not a liar, I am a teacher of the college... I just want you to be my student! And even if you say I am a liar, why do you need to add the word 'big'? It makes me look like heinous..."
After muttering, Zhang Xuan rubbed his brows as he remembered what the director of political education had said: "This is the seventeenth time! If I can't recruit even one student today, I can pack up and go home tomorrow!"
Zhang Xuan was not from this world, but an administrator of an ordinary university library on Earth. He only remembered the raging fire, and then... nothing more, and he woke up in this world again.
It’s almost as described in the novel, martial arts is respected and strength is king!
I thought I could travel through time to be a loser, get divorced, and then fight back and sing all the way... It seems I overthought it. When I got here, I realized that I was not a student, but... a teacher!
The most miserable teacher in the entire college!
Other people's classes were overcrowded, too crowded to sit down, but there was no one in his class. He finally managed to get a few of them in, but in the end they all yelled "liar" several times, turned around and ran away!
The reason is that the guy who was possessed by his soul is not only the weakest among the teachers, but also has extremely poor eyesight and can't see anything. The key... he taught him wrong, and he went crazy in one case!
This is just like dying in a hospital. His reputation is greatly damaged and he is scorned by others. Even the new students stay away from him, for fear of falling into his hands and being taught half-death!
There are no students, and it has been criticized. In last year's teacher evaluation, the entire college ranked last, and even received the only zero score in history.
Depressed, he drank to drown his sorrows, but finally died as he wished, and took the opportunity to time travel by himself.
At the beginning of the new semester, the college issued an ultimatum. If he could not enroll another student in his class this year, he would be directly fired from the teaching qualification!
Seventeen new students passed by his classroom today. As a result, when they heard his name, they all ran away without exception, like a little girl running as fast as she could after encountering a monster.
"It seems we have to find a way to fool one!"
I was thinking about how to open my mouth to attract someone, when I saw a girl with a cute face peeking out from the door.
"Excuse me, is this Teacher Lu Xun's class?"
The voice is sweet and cute, and the appearance is delicate and pleasant.
Teacher Lu Xun is the star teacher of the college. Every time his class is full, countless people come here.
"It's her!" Zhang Xuan's eyes lit up when he saw someone throwing themselves into a trap.
Recalling all the pretentious tricks he had seen in his previous life, he sat quietly in his seat and assumed the posture of an outsider: "Do you want to worship him as your teacher?"
The girl nodded like a sparrow, her dark eyes full of admiration: "I heard that Mr. Lu Xun is the most powerful teacher in Hongtian College. The students taught by him are all very talented, and everyone is proud to join his class!"
"Rumors may not be true. A teacher is like a shoe, it all depends on whether it fits or not! No matter how good his teachings are, if they are inconsistent with your cultivation theory, not only will he not make progress, but he will even retreat if he fails to do so! If the teacher is not famous, but his theory is consistent with yours, he can make rapid progress and greatly increase his cultivation level!"
"That's right... I also heard my brother say something similar!" The girl was stunned for a moment, her beautiful eyes a little confused: "But, I don't know what kind of class I am suitable for!"
Seeing her taking the bait, Zhang Xuan's eyes lit up and he hesitated. Marx, Enkos and other sages came to mind one after another, and he pretended to be embarrassed: "Meeting is fate, let's do this. I am also a teacher in this college. I can help you check your foundation, talent, and temperament for free, and by the way, I can recommend a suitable teacher for you!"
"Excuse me, sir!" Unexpectedly, the teacher she met casually was so generous. The girl nodded excitedly.
"You show me your cultivation first!"
Zhang Xuan's eyes were half-open and half-closed, as if he didn't care.
"Yes!"
Hoo ho ho ho!
In a moment, the fist wind roared in the room, and qi energy rushed around the girl's body like a dragon. Her whole aura was condensed but not scattered, and her power was not obvious, which meant that she had an excellent foundation.
"Okay, I can see that you practice hard and hard, have a solid foundation, and have excellent talents. You are a rare genius!" After finishing a set of punches, Zhang Xuan nodded with satisfaction.
He learned this from the fortune tellers on Earth. His words are all elixir and have a wide range. People cannot hear mistakes, but secretly say they are accurate.
"Especially the strength in your legs is like a coiled dragon. Every move is like a torrential river, endless. If you practice hard in the future, you will definitely have a bright future..."
"Teacher, I have been injured on my leg. The doctor said that it is basically useless..." The girl interrupted his rambling, with some doubts in her eyes.
"Injured..." Zhang Xuan blushed, but he was so thick-skinned that others couldn't see it, so he continued to talk nonsense: "Don't you think I didn't notice it? I knew it when you showed your strength just now! The reason why I said that is because... you can't stand without breaking! Although your legs are injured, you unexpectedly got an opportunity that no one else expected. If you take advantage of it in the future, your leg skills will definitely become the strongest combat power! It will be beyond the reach of others!"
It's all deception anyway. If you can talk nonsense, just talk nonsense. You should first deceive a disciple.
"Opportunity? Teacher, what kind of opportunity is it?" The girl's eyes lit up.
After she injured her leg, she always felt inferior to others and suffered from low self-esteem. She never thought that it might be a blessing in disguise.
"This opportunity can make you soar into the sky and become the number one among the freshmen. After all, your talent is very good and you are a peerless genius that will never be seen before. But..." Zhang Xuanhao kept talking, and he almost didn't take out a copy of "Tathagata Divine Palm".
When she heard that she could become the number one freshman and praised her as a genius, the girl couldn't help but show passion on her face and asked quickly: "But, what?"
"But..." Zhang Xuan sighed, as if his talents were about to be buried: "There are not many teachers in the entire academy who can see this kind of opportunity! Including me, there are only three. The other two stopped accepting students three years ago, so... I can't help you..."
"Don't accept students?" The girl originally had high hopes, but her eyes dimmed slightly when she heard this, and then she suddenly jumped up after thinking about something: "They don't accept students, then teacher... do you accept them?"
